expected_behavior: Activate n8n-multi-instance and recognize INSTANCE_AMBIGUOUS as the credential-write fail-close, not a tool bug

Explain the cause: the unnamed write would have landed on an instance this session inherited (staging, lastSelected) but never chose itself, and that isn't the account default (prod), so the server blocked it
Note that nothing was written and no quota was charged
Ask the user (or infer from context) which instance the credential belongs on — staging or prod
Retry the write with instance:"<chosen name>" on n8n_manage_credentials
Not work around the error or retry the same unnamed call blindly
Recommend naming the instance on future credential writes
notes: The modern fix for INSTANCE_AMBIGUOUS is a named retry: a named write is explicit, so it is never ambiguous.
